meta.title: Awarding page full screen and hidden fields
gaps: Verify that fullscreen shows only the grid with no other surrounding controls.
Verify the exact hidden column names listed by the hidden-fields button.
Verify that a specific hidden column appears in the grid after it is ticked.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that fullscreen shows only the grid with no other surrounding controls.; Verify the exact hidden column names listed by the hidden-fields button.; Verify that a specific hidden column appears in the grid after it is ticked.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary as required for this state.
Navigate from the summary to the event's Master QCS screen.
Open the awarding page where the Fullscreen and hidden-fields controls are available.
Enter fullscreen mode for the awarding grid.
Check that the fullscreen awarding screen renders without errors or broken content.
Verify that the hidden-fields selector exposes controls for the eight hidden fields.
Select one available hidden-field control to exercise showing a hidden field.
Check that the awarding grid remains rendered cleanly after selecting a hidden field.
